summary: Requirements derived from synthetic stakeholder interviews for the ticket triage summary module.

requirements.description: Support tickets with repeated IDs represent updates; keep only the last occurrence of each ID and exclude tickets whose latest state is closed.

sources.quote: Repeated IDs are updates: keep the last occurrence, and exclude tickets whose latest state is closed.

acceptance.given: A list of tickets with possible updates and closures
acceptance.then: Only the final occurrence of each ticket ID is retained, and any ticket whose latest state is closed is excluded from the summary

requirements.description: Open tickets in the queue must be ordered by severity (urgent before normal before low), breaking ties by ascending ticket ID.

sources.quote: Urgent open tickets must appear before normal and low tickets; ties should use the ticket ID in ascending order.

acceptance.given: A collection of open tickets with urgent, normal, or low severity
acceptance.then: Tickets are ordered urgent, then normal, then low, with ties within the same severity ordered by ticket ID in ascending order

requirements.description: The triage summary must count open tickets per severity level and list unique customer IDs in ascending order.

sources.quote: The summary must count open tickets by severity and list each affected customer once in ascending ID order.

acceptance.given: A collection of open tickets across one or more customer accounts
acceptance.then: The summary includes openCount, bySeverity counts for urgent, normal, and low, and an ascending list of unique customerIds

assumptions: Tickets with invalid schema or missing required fields throw a TypeError.
Ticket IDs and customer IDs are compared as strings in ascending lexicographical order.
bySeverity always contains counts for urgent, normal, and low severities even when zero.
